note: Alberta Parks recreation area on the Brazeau Reservoir, about 60 km SW of Drayton Valley on Hwy 620. West Canal is a small, well-treed loop of gravel-pad drive-in sites with a boat launch, fish-cleaning station and group shelter. Reservoir fishing, boating and canoeing; OHV trails nearby, prohibited in the campground. Operated by Westward Bound Campgrounds. --Claude
